core_obligations: Prove the case r = 1 directly from the definition (proof lines 7274-7276).
For r larger than 1, form the short exact sequence of complexes exhibiting multiplication by f_1 on the tail Koszul complex (proof lines 7276-7281).
Identify the Koszul complex of the full sequence with the cone on that multiplication and use the long exact sequence to transfer acyclicity (proof lines 7281-7295).
Conclude that f_1 to f_r is M-Koszul-regular, hence that a regular sequence is Koszul-regular (proof lines 7295-7298).
proof_roadmap: Write the short exact sequence of complexes with multiplication by the first element (proof lines 7276-7281).
Identify the full Koszul complex with the cone and use the long exact sequence (proof lines 7281-7298).
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that the naive regularity condition on the successive quotients by the previous elements is equivalent to Koszul regularity, and the proof is a 26-line induction. It splits the sequence into its first element and the rest, forms the short exact sequence of Koszul complexes in which multiplication by the first element appears, identifies the Koszul complex of the full sequence with the cone on that map, and then uses the long exact sequence of the cone to transfer acyclicity from the tail complex to the full one. The identification with the cone is the step that carries the content.
